## Engineering reading {#engineering-reading}

Adds the DSL surface __init__.py as dependency of every generated file. It was excluded from module INPUTS but carries global version/alias state, so changing protocol version could otherwise leave generated latest aliases stale. Two-line build fix; no new tests.
